results.title: All set for ISRO's state-of-art imaging satellite launch, first from Geosynchronous orbit
results.description: ISRO has commenced the countdown for the launch of a state-of-the-art Earth observation spacecraft on Friday, which will be India's first ever imaging satellite from the Geosynchronous orbit, official sources said.
